latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — provides a practical playbook for solopreneurs to build and manage product roadmaps.

- Step-by-step guidance on prioritizing, structuring, and communicating a product roadmap.
- Explains how to gather and evaluate feature ideas using RICE and Value vs Effort frameworks.
- Covers integrating customer feedback and managing feature requests.
- Includes best practices for reviewing and updating your roadmap quarterly.
- Designed to help stay focused on outcomes, avoid feature bloat, and set clear customer expectations.
